Synthetic audio interoperability fixtures.

legacy_*.silk: generated by SILK SDK FIX v1.0.9, complexity 2,
24 kbit/s target, Tencent header, input rates named in each file.
*_24000.pcm: corresponding reference SDK output at 24 kHz, mono PCM16LE.
The 40/60/100ms files cover multiple internal frames in one packet.
Duration inspection counts those internal 20 ms frames without producing PCM;
the interop tests compare its duration with these native PCM fixture lengths.

rust_*.silk: produced by this crate's encoder.
*_native.pcm: decoded from those packets by the reference C SDK at the
input sample rate. These fixtures check interoperability without compiling
or linking C in this crate's tests.

All signals are generated sine mixtures, chirps and silence; no user audio.
